title: rhododendron borneense subsp. angustissimum
intro: Rhododendron borneense subsp. angustissimum, commonly known as Tibetan rhododendron, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in Tibetan medicine. The health benefits of Tibetan rhododendron include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Tibetan rhododendron include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as modulating the immune system, reducing oxidative stress, and exhibiting potential anti-cancer properties.
